page.layout: One column of lexicon entries, Hebrew and Latin mixed, with a running head centred at the top and the page number at top left. Catchword "C" at bottom left.

main_text.p: בָּרֶךְ f. Genu: duale, בִּרְכַּיִם Genua. Chald. בִּרְכוֹהִי Genua sua, Dan.6.11.
בְּרָכָה f. Benedictio: Gratiarum actio: plur. בִּרְכוֹת.
בְּרוֹמִים m.p. Vestes pretiosæ, juxta Hebræos.
בָּרָק m. Fulgur, Corusca tio, Fulgor: Gladius fulgens, Job.20.25: plur. בְּרָקִים.
בָּרַר Expurgavit, Purificavit, Declaravit: item, Elegit, Selegit. Niphal, נִבּוֹר & Hithpahel הִתְבָּרֵר Purificari, Purificare se. Pihel, בֵּרֵר. Hiphil הֵבֵר Purgavit.
בַּר m. Mundus Purus: plur. בָּרִים.
בְּרִית f. idem, ab Expurgandis sordib. dictum.
בַּרְבָּרִים m.p. Capones, juxta Hebræos: Quidam, Selectissima altilia, 1.Reg.4 23.
בְּרוֹשׁ בְּרֹשׁ m. Abies: plur. בְּרוֹשִׁים.
בְּרִית בְּרִית Vide paulò ante in בְּרָה.
בְּרוֹרִים m. Bruta arbor, vel Abies: plur.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel pointing is hard to read at this scale; several Hebrew forms, especially the pointing in the entries for בְּרוֹשׁ, בְּרִית and בְּרוֹרִים, are uncertain and may differ in their vowel signs. The bold/italic distinction of the headwords is approximate.
